instruction: Use the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools to update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a ventilation network where earlier coordination split the supply air run into legacy groupings. The commissioning engineer wants the system rationalised into one continuous supply-air network while preserving the seven physical ventilation products and their nested ports. Replace the legacy grouping with a single supply-air system, keep each product assigned, complete the missing port-to-port relationships, and add balancing/status data so the two terminals and connecting ductwork can be checked as one coordinated system. Record the updated system with revision code BONSAI-CLI-17.
